capex.metric: Total capital cost, 4 x 5.6 MW natural-gas reciprocating engine (RICE) plant, 21.4 MW net

Contractor final Rev. 1 dated 9 December 2019; EIA report February 2020; r.jina.ai Published Time Wed, 05 Feb 2020. Fetched via r.jina.ai.

capex.metric: Overnight capital cost per kW net, 4 x 5.6 MW natural-gas RICE plant
capex.basis: Same EIA/Sargent & Lundy Case 4: 'The base cost estimate for this technology case totals $1810/kW' and table row '$/kW net 1,810', in 2019 $s. EIA report February 2020; fetched via r.jina.ai.
